summary.whatChanges: In the Hono RPC client (`hc`), WebSocket URLs built by `$ws()` now strip a trailing `/index` segment before parameter substitution, so `client.index.$ws()` connects to the root path instead of `/index`. Path parameter values equal to "index" are preserved. Tests updated accordingly.
behaviorChanges: `client.index.$ws()` now opens a connection to `ws://host/` rather than `ws://host/index`, matching how non-WebSocket RPC calls resolve index routes.
Query parameters are appended to the normalized root URL (e.g. `ws://localhost/?id=123`).
A dynamic route param whose value is `index` (e.g. `$ws({ param: { id: 'index' } })`) still produces `ws://host/index`, since normalization happens before param replacement.
risks: Any server or proxy that was actually listening on the literal `/index` WebSocket path will no longer receive connections from this client.
Normalization is applied only to the `ws` branch; if `removeIndexString` matches more broadly than intended (e.g. paths ending in `index` for other reasons), URLs could be altered unexpectedly.
